# DEVPROOF – full page text (English)

> Plain-text copy of https://devproof.no/en/ for LLM agents. Norwegian page: https://devproof.no/. Summary: https://devproof.no/llms.txt

## Stop explaining. Start proving.

For developers and agencies · Windows

DEVPROOF connects your working day in Git, GitHub, VS Code and Claude Code to what you actually delivered – and gives your client a report with your own logo.

Stored locally · No screen recording · No lock-in beyond the paid year

- from NOK 1,250: first year, excl. VAT
- 1 click: from working day to client report
- 0 hours: logged by hand
- 100%: local on your PC

Pulls from: Git, GitHub, VS Code, Claude Code, Windows activity

## The problem

“What have you actually done?”

You shipped commits, pull requests and releases. The timesheet says “development 7.5 h”. DEVPROOF connects your time to your deliveries, so the client sees the work – and you no longer have to defend the invoice.

- **Time with a source**: Your working day is recorded from your PC, VS Code, Claude Code and Git. Every hour points to something you can show.
- **Deliveries from GitHub**: Commits, pull requests and releases are fetched automatically and linked to the right project and client.
- **A report with your logo**: One button gives your client a clean PDF with your logo and colour, clickable references and a clear line between documented and estimated.

## How it works

From working day to client report.

No manual timesheets. No guessing what you did on Tuesday.

- Projects are detected automatically from Git, VS Code and GitHub
- The timeline shows your whole day – click a time span to see what documents it
- Client, hourly rate and deliveries gathered per project
- Reports as PDF, CSV and JSON, in English or Norwegian
- Estimates are always labelled as estimates, never as facts

## The client report

This is what your client gets.

Your logo on the cover, deliveries with clickable GitHub references, and figures where documented and estimated are always kept apart.

- **Your brand**: Your own logo and colour on the cover. The client sees you – not the tool.
- **Verifiable**: Every delivery links to a commit, pull request or release on GitHub.
- **Honest numbers**: Documented time and estimates are shown separately. Nothing is dressed up.

Sample report · 3 pages · PDF · fictional client, in Norwegian: https://devproof.no/assets/eksempel-kunderapport.pdf

## Privacy first

Your work. Your machine.

Built for developers who refuse to be monitored.

- **No screen recording**: DEVPROOF never takes screenshots and never reads the content of what you work on.
- **No keylogging**: Only when you are active, never what you type. Code, prompts and passwords are not stored.
- **Everything stays local**: Your data lives on your PC. Nothing is shared with the client until you export the report yourself.

## FAQ

Can’t find the answer? Write to edin@nokto.no.

### What happens after I pay?

You go straight to the download, and you get an email from us within one working day.

### Does it work on Mac or Linux?

Windows only for now.

### Can my client see my data?

No. Everything is stored locally on your PC. The client only sees the report you choose to export and send.

### Do I need GitHub?

GitHub provides deliveries and projects automatically. Time from your PC, VS Code and Claude Code is recorded without it too.

### Is the app in English?

The app itself is in Norwegian today. Client reports can be created in English or Norwegian.

### Can I cancel?

Yes. The subscription is paid one year in advance and renews automatically. Email edin@nokto.no before the renewal date and we stop the renewal. You keep access for the period you have paid for. Periods already paid are not refunded.
